newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Super Coffeemix up on first-half results.
newsitem.headline: Super Coffeemix up on first-half results.

text.p: Shares in food company Super Coffeemix Manufacturing Ltd rose four percent, or 3.7 cents, to a high of 84.5 Singapore cents on Friday after the company reported a sharp rise in its first-half profits.
By 0230 GMT, the stock stood at 84 cents, up three cents, with 1.6 million shares traded. The company's warrants were unchanged at 65.5 cents with more than two million traded.
Super Coffeemix reported a 146 percent year-on-year rise in net profit for the six months ending June 30, 1996, to S$5.12 million from S$2.08 million a year ago.

"It's a good solid profit rise," said one institutional dealer with a large local bank. "Looking at the company's results, the improvement came from higher turnover and expanding into new markets -- very healthy."
